name: Agavolem
ability: Rough Skin / Sand Veil / Sap Sipper (hidden)
look: a rugged cracked-terracotta golem with a huge spiny blue agave heart bursting from its chest
entry: Agavolem spends decades absorbing desert sunlight into its spiky core. When baked by volcanic heat, its sap turns into a sweet, fiery nectar.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Roast & Press at level 17.
